path_accounting.basis: gds_bytes = nvidia-fs readMiB delta (layer 3, true GPU-direct only); bounced_or_posix_bytes = app - gds (cuFile bounce or kvikio posix; the kvikio compat fields say which layer)
path_accounting.scope: cell-global: nvidia-fs deltas are device-global, so rank 0's snapshot window covers all ranks; app_bytes_read = aligned cuFile bytes summed across ranks. The wrapper's 1 Hz nvidia-fs timeline is the cell-level authority (D-6).
